title: Hydrogen storage capacity of carbon nanotubes, filaments, and vapor-grown fibers
material_description: Nd2Fe14B | Nd2Fe14B intermetallic (not a carbon sorbent) used as a calibration check of the PCI system; 3.18 g sample
source_location: Table 1, row Nd2Fe14B, PCI system (3.59 MPa) column; Section 2.2.2 text and Fig. 12 (soak-mode test)
notes: Non-carbon calibration check (not a carbon sorbent under protocol section 3); extracted because Table 1 prints the value. Table 1 lists 0.19 in the PCI (3.59 MPa) column but Section 2.2.2 and Fig. 12 describe it as a soak-mode test: 3.18 g heated to 475 K in 120 kPa hydrogen, then cooled to room temperature (297.6 K); pressure difference of about 15 kPa in 1.049 L = 2.98e-3 mol H2 = 6.03e-3 g H2 = 0.19 wt.%. Conditions recorded here (297.6 K, 120 kPa = 1.2 bar) are the text's, not the table's (23 C, 3.59 MPa). Both compared states are at room temperature, so coded isothermal, but the sample was heated to 475 K and cooled before the comparison. Basis coded by the instrumental default; excess versus absolute is not meaningful for bulk hydride absorption.
